title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:COURTESY LIGHTS (1,306 affected)
summary: THE AISLE ILLUMINATING FLUORESCENT TUBES ABOVE THE PARCEL RACKS ARE EXPOSED, AND CAN BREAK ON CONTACT WITH PARCELS OR PASSENGER'S HANDS.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG (25,059 affected)
summary: THE STEERING WHEEL CENTER HUB CAN FRACTURE DURING CERTAIN FRONTAL AND NEAR FRONTAL VEHICLE COLLISIONS.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG (211,306 affected)
summary: THE STEERING WHEEL CENTER HUB CAN FRACTURE DURING CERTAIN FRONTAL AND NEAR FRONTAL VEHICLE COLLISIONS.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:HOSE:FLUID (1,184 affected)
summary: THE POWER STEERING RETURN HOSE WAS INCORRECTLY ROUTED, AND COULD KINK AND REDUCE POWER STEERING ASSIST.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: STRUCTURE:BODY:WHEEL WELL (403 affected)
summary: THE OUTSIDE TIRE ON THE REAR AXLE CAN CONTACT THE INSIDE SURFACE OF THE SIDEWALL WHEN THE VEHICLE IS IN TRANSIT ON A ROUGH SURFACED ROAD.

title: MONACO COACH CORPORATION: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING (265 affected)
summary: THE FUEL PUMP SECONDARY THROTTLE RETURN SPRING ATTACHED DIRECTLY TO THE DIESEL ENGINE FUEL PUMP THROTTLE ARM WAS NOT INSTALLED.

title: General Motors, LLC: POWER TRAIN:OTHER PART (633 affected)
summary: THE TRANSAXLE VALVE ASSEMBLIES WERE IMPROPERLY MACHINED. VEHICLES MAY NOT PROPERLY ENGAGE IN NEUTRAL OR PARK, EVEN THOUGH THE GEAR SELECTOR INDICATES THE VEHICLE IS IN NEUTRAL OR PARK.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (637 affected)
summary: SOME OF THESE VEHICLES ARE EQUIPPED WITH A THROTTLE HOUSING ON WHICH THE THROTTLE VALVE SHAFT RETAINING NUT WAS NOT SUFFICIENTLY TIGHTENED.

title: Ford Motor Company: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:BRAKE LIGHTS (43,000 affected)
summary: THE STOP LAMP SWITCHES COULD INTERMITTENTLY MALFUNCTION RESULTING IN THE STOP LAMPS NOT ILLUMINATING WHEN THE BRAKES ARE APPLIED.

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:HIGH/LOW BEAM DIMMER (360,399 affected)
summary: THERE CAN BE INTERFERENCE WITH THE HEADLAMP HOUSING IF HEADLAMP BULBS ARE REPLACED WITH ANY BRAND OTHER THAN KOITO BRAND BULBS.

title: HONORBUILT TRAILERS, INC.: STRUCTURE:BUMPER ASSEMBLY (74 affected)
summary: SPARE TIRE CARRIER MOUNTED TO THE 4X4 TUBE BUMPER AT THE TRUCK EXTENSION CAN CAUSE STRESS AT THE WELDS AND TEAR LOOSE.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK (20 affected)
summary: THE VEHICLES WERE ASSEMBLED WITH AN INCORRECT SUSPENSION UPPER SPRING SEAT AT THE RIGHT-REAR POSITION. IF THE VEHICLE IS INVOLVED IN A REAR IMPACT ACCIDENT, THE RIGHT-HAND REAR WHEEL HOUSE FLANGE COULD SEVER THE FUEL TANK FILLER PIPE AND SPILL FUEL.

title: International Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY (185,000 affected)
summary: THE FUEL SYSTEM FAILED THE CRASH BARRIER TEST.

title: Shyft Group: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT SHOCK ABSORBER (1,400 affected)
summary: THE LENGTH OF THE FRONT SHOCK ABSORBERS IS INADEQUATE, RESULTING IN BENDING AND BREAKING OF THE SHOCK ABSORBER BRACKETS.

title: Shyft Group: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR (1,400 affected)
summary: AN INADEQUATE WELD ON THE TRACK BAR BRACKET TO THE REAR AXLE CAN BREAK AND THE BRACKET CAN SEPARATE FROM THE REAR AXLE.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (200 affected)
summary: THE POTABLE WATER TANK SUPPORT BRACKETS WERE FOUND TO HAVE INADEQUATE STRENGTH TO SUPPORT THE TANK DURING TRANSIT.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (29,986 affected)
summary: THE FUEL TANK LEAKED AS A RESULT OF IMPACT TESTING PERFORMED BY HARLEY-DAVIDSON.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG:PASSENG (11 affected)
summary: THE PASSENGER SIDE AIRBAG ASSEMBLY WAS PRODUCED WITHOUT IGNITER MATERIAL.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:HINGE AND ATTACHMENTS (49,300 affected)
summary: TRUCKS USED IN THE SALT-BELT STATES CAN HAVE ACCUMULATED CORROSION IN THE HINGES OF THE REAR DOORS. IF THE VEHICLES ALSO HAVE MISALIGNED DOOR LATCHES AND STRIKERS, IT IS POSSIBLE TO CLOSE THE DOORS IN A "FALSE LATCH" CONDITION.

title: CHANCE COACH, INC.: STEERING:COLUMN:TILT (529 affected)
summary: THE WELDS ON A BRACKET WHICH ATTACHES THE TILT- TELESCOPING STEERING COLUMN TO THE FIREWALL UNDER THE DASH ARE DEFECTIVE AND COULD FAIL.

title: KELLY SPRINGFIELD TIRE CO: TIRES (1,000 affected)
summary: SOME TIRES WERE OVERCURED BECAUSE OF AN INTERMITTENT PRESS CURE TIMER MALFUNCTION.

title: FEDERA-MOGUL CORPORATION: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:OTHER PART LIGHTING SYSTEM (11,939 affected)
summary: THE HEADLAMP EXPERIENCES A REDUCED LIGHT OUTPUT IN THE LOW BEAM FUNCTION BECAUSE OF A REVERSAL OF THE HIGH BEAM WIRE AND THE GROUND WIRE.
